## Description

R15: The `triage-ideas` skill lists open ideas that have no area.
R16: The `triage-ideas` skill assigns an area with `canon supersede --type composer:idea`.
R17: The `triage-ideas` skill creates a `composer:area` with `canon create --type composer:area` when no area fits.
R18: The `triage-ideas` skill dismisses an idea with `canon supersede --type composer:idea` to status `dismissed`.
R19: The `triage-ideas` skill does not set status `promoted`; it names `engage` for that.

## Approach

Create `skills/triage-ideas/SKILL.md` modeled on `skills/settle-phase/SKILL.md`: frontmatter `name: triage-ideas` and a description; follow the shared `kinds-and-focus.md` and `ensure-store.md` references the other skills use (copy or link them the same way `engage` does); parent session writes, no subagent writes. Steps: run `orchestra handoff` if needed; list untriaged ideas with `canon list --type composer:idea --where payload.status=open --state active --full` and keep those with no `area`; list areas with `canon list --type composer:area --state active --full`; present each idea with options (assign an area, create a new area, dismiss, leave) and a recommendation; the user decides; write with `canon create --type composer:area` (payload `title`, body with `## Scope`), `canon supersede --type composer:idea --id <id> --expected-revision <revision> --payload '{"area":"<area-slug>"}'` for an area, and `canon supersede ... --payload '{"status":"dismissed"}'` for a dismiss; end by naming `engage` for promotion and never set status `promoted`. Add the skill to the README skill table. Write `tests/test_triage_ideas_skill.py` in the style of `tests/test_settle_phase_skill.py`, using `skill_extraction.extract_invocations`.
